description: This file defines the ReadableOrder class, representing an order entity with associated customer, products, currency, billing, and delivery information, along with totals such as total, tax, and shipping.

classes.name: ReadableOrder
classes.description: A class extending OrderEntity that encapsulates order details, including customer information, products, currency, billing & delivery addresses, and totals.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax total for the order.

methods.name: setTax
methods.description: Sets the tax total for the order.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping total for the order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyModel
methods.description: Returns the currency model used for the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyModel
methods.description: Sets the currency model used for the order.
